notes.title: HOLA, AMIGOS! Meet version 1.06!
notes.content:
[b] You waited and we released a big update! [/b]
The widget has become much more convenient.
What's new:
[list]
[*] ¡Spanish language!
[*] New features in the tray
[*] Window memory
[*] Compact form
[*] Docking over all windows
[*] Hidden launch without indication on Steam
[*] Several more bugs fixed
[/list]

[img] https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34595505/e76db40c8e251bc011adf2931e442fffb360197f.png [/img]

[b]Hope you enjoy![/b]
As usual, write your wishes in the comments!

notes.title: Upgrade to version 1.05
notes.content:
Good news, Everyone!
We have updated our application and are happy to share it with you.
[list]
    [*]Added multilanguage
    [*]Fixed some bugs
[/list]
[i]Write in your reviews what other languages you would like to see.[/i]

[b]Stay tuned and thanks for choosing our app![/b]
